color-primary-50: Ghost button hover, table row hover, active nav item, focus ring fill.
color-primary-100: Soft fills, sidebar dividers, avatar backgrounds.
color-primary-300: Focus outline on buttons, secondary button hover border.
color-primary-500: Main brand rose; start of the primary button gradient; input focus border.
color-primary-600: Secondary and ghost button text, sort arrows.
color-primary-700: End of the primary button gradient; active nav item text.
color-accent-50: End of the table header gradient.
color-accent-500: Main red accent; start of the accent button gradient.
color-success: Approved, active; success badge, toast and button.
color-warning: Pending, needs attention; warning badge, toast and button.
color-error: Rejected, failed, destructive actions; error badge, toast, input error border.
color-error-light: Error badge background, error focus ring fill.
color-info: Informational and in-progress states; info badge and toast.
color-gray-100: Muted badge background, disabled input fill.
color-text-secondary: Secondary text, hints, meta, section labels.
color-text-disabled: Disabled text and inactive nav icons.
color-text-on-primary: Text on rose, red and semantic fills.
color-divider: Hairline dividers inside cards and table rows.
